## F — Structured research index and consolidated VERIFY list: emergencies and crashes
Knowledge facts: part C holds 41 fact blocks (sec13-F01 onward) from physical pages 77 to 80; part C2 holds 10 confusable-pair blocks (sec13-R01 onward).
Exam authority: part A states issuer, handbook revision and test structure; question count, passing score and time limit are unknown.
VERIFY list:
- NC-EMG-A-EXAM — knowledge-test question count, passing score and time limit not printed in the handbook (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- NC-EMG-MARKET — market pack unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
- NC-EMG-TEARDOWN — competitive teardown unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
Dynamic facts: the animal-collision phone number (sec13-F03) and the crash reporting dollar threshold (sec13-F37) can change and must be refreshed from the official source.

corpus_stability.reason: The handbook prints a single revision date (Revised May 2025) on its back cover and states laws and fees are subject to change by the General Assembly; no sign of more than one revision per year in the selected pages.
